facts.value: Internal action-entry helper with signature static void (HSD_GObj*). The borrowed game-object pointer supplies the attached Fighter whose FloatAttack latch is initialized and is forwarded unchanged to common aerial entry. No local allocation, destruction, ownership transfer, or pointer retention occurs.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified signature and attachment while removing unsupported broader ownership semantics.

evidence.why: Static declaration, Fighter lookup, field initialization, and forwarding.

facts.value: Fighter action-state animation callback with signature void (HSD_GObj*). It receives a borrowed game-object pointer, accesses its attached Fighter, updates duration and facing, and may delegate a motion transition. The body does not establish broader object ownership or compiled parameter-register assignment.
facts.rationale: Replaces ownership wording with the source-supported input contract.

facts.value: Each invocation delegates to exactly one physics routine: zero floatattack.x0 selects ftPe_Float_Phys; nonzero selects ft_80084DB0. The wrapper has no local timer or transition logic. Entry clears x0; continuation failure sets it before IASA arbitration. Release persists only until re-entry or another state change: a successful chained attack can clear the latch during the same IASA invocation that set it.
facts.rationale: Repairs unqualified one-way-for-state wording and explicitly accounts for indirect IASA reset.

evidence.why: Entry clear, continuation write, chained gate, and exclusive physics branches.

facts.value: Attack requests require u.pe.x4 > 0. FloatAttack entry clears mv.pe.floatattack.x0; IASA sets it when continuation fails, before checking allow_interrupt. A set latch selects common aerial physics and Fall at animation completion, whereas a clear latch selects Float physics and requests Float with false, without replenishing duration. Timer exhaustion alone does not set the latch or immediately end the attack. Interruptible IASA tries ftCo_80095328, the local attack gate, then ftCo_800CB870; successful chained entry may clear the latch in the same invocation that set it. Collision delegates to common aerial landing, whose unmatched Float-specific motions select basic landing.
facts.rationale: Independently verified librarian refinement distinguishes duration from release and bounds latch lifetime.

evidence.why: False entry preserves duration; Float processes exhaustion separately.

facts.value: Forwards the borrowed game object and ftCo_LandingAir_EnterWithLag function address to ft_80082C74. That helper synchronously invokes the callback only when ft_80081D0C succeeds and does not retain it. With a FloatAttack motion, the landing routine selects basic landing whether cmd_vars[0] is clear or set, because only ordinary AttackAir motions match its switch. The unmatched path does not read its uninitialized lag local or execute lag-reduction division/conversion.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified landing mechanism while making callback lifetime and optional command branch explicit, without asserting fixed landing duration.

evidence.why: Command guard, motion switch, guarded lag usage, and basic fallback.
